title: read + listing endpoints
instruction: Add `GET /api/products` returning all products with their current stock. Add `GET /api/orders` (authenticated with `Authorization: Token <token>`) returning the authenticated user's orders, newest first, with an optional `?status=placed|canceled` query filter.

title: restock
instruction: Add `POST /api/products/{sku}/restock` accepting `{ "quantity": <positive integer> }` that increases the product's available `stock` by that quantity and returns the updated product. Added stock is reflected in availability checks for new orders.

title: audit log
instruction: Add an append-only audit log recording every order placement and every cancellation, exposed via `GET /api/orders/audit` returning `{ "type": "order_placed"|"order_canceled", "orderId": string, "userId": string, "at": ISO-8601 }` in chronological order.

title: reporting + order versioning
instruction: Add `GET /api/report` returning `{ "perProduct": [{ "sku": string, "unitsSold": int, "revenueCents": int }], "totalUnitsSold": int, "totalRevenueCents": int }` counting only placed (non-canceled) orders. Add a `version` integer to every order that starts at 1 and increments on each mutation (cancel increments it).
